title: Kokoro cross-repository boundary registry
description: Wave T0 contract foundation, stored as JSON-compatible YAML at contract/registry/boundaries.yaml. Every cross-repository boundary declares its owner, callers, audience, protocol, deadline, retry class, receipt and failure owner, and freezes exactly one transport per operation. scripts/contract/check-boundary-registry.mjs enforces this schema plus the source-parity, transport-freeze and isolation-axis rules, and fails if the enums below drift from contract/proto/kokoro/common/v1/error.proto.

scope.description: site = Platform business isolation. platform = cross-Site platform plane. namespace = GA runtime isolation.

retryClass.description: Mirrors kokoro.common.v1.RetryClass minus its proto3 zero sentinel. The gate re-derives this list from the proto and fails on drift.

receiptKind.description: How a caller re-reads the authoritative outcome of an effectful operation.

siteBinding.description: How the operation binds its Site. request-field = a first-class field of the request message, which the gate verifies against the real contract source. context-header = carried out of band and re-derived per route, which the spec (§6.3) forbids as a long-term answer, so the gate counts it as migration debt. not-applicable = the boundary does not isolate by Site.

sourceStatus.description: Whether this repository holds a contract source for the boundary. machine-readable = sources is non-empty and the gate enforces exact two-way parity between declared operations and that source. declared-only = no contract source exists here yet, so no orphan check can run; the gate counts these boundaries on every successful run so the blind spot stays visible instead of passing as covered.

boundary.description: An exact root id from config/architecture/index-roots.yaml with kind=boundary, nested inside repository.

source.description: A machine-readable contract source. The set of operations it declares must equal the registered operation set exactly, in both directions.

transport.description: Must appear in the owning boundary's transports list. One operation, one transport, forever.

receipt.description: Required whenever effect is true; null otherwise.

id.description: Must match a contract id in config/repository/compatibility-matrix.json.

audience.description: Who ultimately reaches this boundary. Two boundaries must not offer one consumer the same operation over different transports.

failureOwner.description: Repository paged when this boundary breaks.

deadlineMs.description: null means no deadline is declared in code yet; it is a recorded gap, not an implied default.

sources.description: Must be non-empty when sourceStatus is machine-readable, and empty when it is declared-only.

transportSource.description: When set, every declared transport must exist as a real channel in this source.
